text_block_list.text:
My first three years of the Twinkle Series 
with Air Shakur have come to an end.

Some time had passed since the sensational 
Arima Kinen, and things around her seemed 
to have finally settled down, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Mm, got it. Then let's head straight to 
training like this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait a second.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's get going.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You're going to train, right? I'll join 
you—as a friend!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You... you're planning to test out those 
experiment results you were talking about 
the other day on me, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Nicely done, Shakur. If you already 
understand, this will be quick.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Oi, we're leaving.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Okaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah. Fine, what is it today?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course, to join in your training! As a 
friend, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ... Cafe, how about you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I want to know... how well I can keep up 
with you right now.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...As a friend?
choice_data_list: You sure have a lot of friends.
You sure have a lot of friends.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Were you listening properly?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All of 'em are sayin' they wanna get ready 
to knock me flat on my ass.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu, did it sound like that?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's how I made it sound to ya, ain't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's no benefit in facing you guys 
right now. If you wanna go against me...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Bring your challenge to the race. I'll 
take you on as many times as you want."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Is that... as a friend?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious? As a hero standing up 
against the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That just makes Shakur look like the 
villain, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"That's what I'm sayin'. If I'd gone down 
long ago, you guys would've climbed a lot 
higher by now."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: To anyone, that's just being a villain.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Still, you're having fun right now, aren't 
you, Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah. —Well, obviously, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Man, those guys were seriously persistent 
today...
choice_data_list:
That's just how much I want to run with 
you.

That's just how much I want to run with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What, are you some kind of weirdo?

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Um...! Shakur-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah?

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...! Someday, I swear I'll surpass you!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Right now, no one appreciates me... Nobody 
understands, but still...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "I will overtake you and prove who I am!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hah.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Do whatever you want. No point in 
announcing it to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll be right there. ...Don't make me 
forget that look on your face, alright?
